question: Which of the following viruses can easily cause a latent infection ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Cytomegalovirus" -> "ability to establish latency in host cells" -> "reactivation potential under immunosuppression" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Parotitis" -> "caused by mumps virus" -> "typically does not establish latency" -> "low likelihood of latent infection" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Hepatitis A" -> "acute viral infection" -> "does not establish latency" -> "no latent infection" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Rage" -> "unclear terminology, possibly referring to rabies" -> "rabies virus can establish latency in neural tissue" -> "potential for latent infection" -> 75%
analysis: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) is known for its ability to establish latent infections in the host. It can remain dormant in the body and reactivate later, particularly in immunocompromised individuals. In contrast, the other options listed do not typically cause latent infections.
